column1: # `dungeon-mode.md §8.1`, electric contact: the step into an `0x83` cell
# prints `Ouch!` then `Electric field!` before any destination test,
# flashes, and pushes the party back to the cell it stepped from. Both
# lines are on the coverage backlog.
# The seed stands one cell south of the field in Covetous facing North,
# so a single Advance is the whole approach - `party_probe` reads the
# facing out of the save rather than the scenario guessing it. Seeded
# with `seed_position <profile> dungeon=37 level=3 x=1 y=6`, the ladder
# cell directly below the `0x83` that `dungeon_class_scan` reports.
# The field damages the party off the shared generator, so the roster
# panel is a **roster lottery** - the comparator reports its rows and
# does not count them. The message window is fixed text, and it is what
# this scenario measures.
